title: The uneven rise of AI-generated web content
abstract: arXiv:2610.36631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In less than five years, generative artificial intelligence (AI) has dramatically reshaped the public-facing web. Using a sample of more than 5 million crawlable webpages, we demonstrate that the share containing AI-generated text has increased precipitously, but unevenly. Our analyses reveal substantial differences in AI composition across language and domain categories (e.g., .edu, .com, or .gov). A higher fraction of English-language webpages contain AI-generated text compared to pages in other languages, and prevalence is substantially lower on .gov and .edu domains compared to .com. These distinctions persist even after accounting for compositional effects. We also find heterogeneity based on a page's position in the connectivity structure of the web. translated_title: AI生成网络内容的不均衡崛起
translated_abstract: 在不到五年的时间里，生成式人工智能（AI）已经极大地重塑了面向公众的互联网。基于超过500万个可抓取网页的样本，我们证明了包含AI生成文本的网页比例急剧上升，但增长并不均衡。我们的分析揭示了AI内容占比在语言和域名类别（如.edu、.com或.gov）之间存在显著差异。与其他语言的网页相比，含有AI生成文本的英语网页比例更高；与.com域名相比，.gov和.edu域名上AI生成文本的普及率明显更低。即使在考虑了构成效应之后，这些差异依然存在。我们还发现了基于网页在互联网连接结构中所处位置的异质性。AI生成文本在网络图中最不中心的网页上最为常见且增长最为迅速，这推动了AI生成文本整体增长的很大一部分。
tldr: 基于500万网页的大规模研究表明，AI生成文本在互联网上急剧增长但分布不均：英语网页和.com域名中AI内容占比更高，而网络图中最边缘化的网页AI内容增长最快，成为整体增长的主要驱动力。
